brief: QQQ has stayed inside its August 4th range for 27 sessions, Bollinger Bands as tight as March, and BTIG expects the eventual break to resolve lower. Nearly 5% of the Russell 3000 hit 52-week lows even as the index sat under 3% from a 52-week high, a split historically a coin flip over 20 days but one that has preceded drops in similar setups going back to 2000. Semis (SOXX) sit below a falling 50-day average with an eventual 200-day test (about 17% lower), while small-caps (IWM) have spent ten days below their 50-day, slope turning down, risking a 200-day test this month despite a still-bullish long-term trend. AUD/JPY, which tracks the S&P, has rolled toward its range's bottom, another equity headwind. Bonds are short-term extended and sentiment is very negative, but 10-year real rates just hit a cycle high after three years of consolidation, making a major top hard to call. Tanker shipping costs (BWET) are up roughly 500% since June and 4,000% year to date, a parabolic move BTIG expects to reverse on uncertain timing. Energy stocks (OIH) fell this week despite WTI above $100, which BTIG reads as risk of a correlation-one event, not as bullish.

cards.claim: BTIG notes QQQ has traded within its August 4th range for 27 trading days without breaking out.
cards.anchor: It’s been 27 trading days since QQQ’s +3.4% surg on 8/4.

cards.claim: BTIG's view is that the QQQ's prolonged range will eventually resolve to the downside.
cards.anchor: our view remains that it will be to the downside.

cards.claim: QQQ's Bollinger Bands are the tightest since March, when the prior tight-band period preceded a downside break.
cards.anchor: The last time they were this tight was in March prior to the downside break.

cards.claim: Nearly 5% of the Russell 3000 made a 52-week low even though the Russell 3000 itself was less than 3% below its 52-week high.
cards.anchor: Nearly 5% of the Russell 3k made a 52wk low on Thursday, with the RAY itself less than 3% from a 52wk high.

cards.claim: Historically, this breadth divergence of elevated new lows near an index high is roughly a coin flip for market direction over the next 20 trading days.
cards.anchor: Historically that’s a coin flip looking out 20 days

cards.claim: Similar breadth setups have preceded notable market drops in March 2000, October 2007, July 2015, September 2018, January 2020, December 2021, and January 2026.
cards.anchor: notable dates preceding meaningful drops with this set-up including: March ’00, Oct. ’07, July ’15, Sep. ’18, Jan. ’20, Dec. ’21, and Jan. ’26.

cards.anchor: 10yr real rates just made a cycle high after three years of consolidation.

cards.claim: BTIG says it is hard to characterize the current level in 10-year real rates as a major top.
cards.anchor: It's hard to say this is a major top for rates.
